# Session 100a Plan — Wave 3: Freeze-in / Envelope Dynamics

**Date**: 2026-06-03
**Author**: transit-dynamics-theorist (generated by /rclab-plan per-wave swarm)
**Owner agent**: transit-dynamics-theorist (the freeze-in block is this wave's compute; envelope + threshold legs route to hawking + phonon-first)
**Plan source**: `sessions/session-plan/session-100a-context.md` §"Item 9 / Item 10 / Item 11" (Wave 3)
**Working paper**: `sessions/session-100a/session-100a-w3-workingpaper.md`

## Wave 3 Summary

Wave 3 tests whether the S99 fermion-mass panel's **transit squeezed-vacuum freeze-in** is an over-constrained predictor of the SM flavor sector, not just a re-description of it. The panel (5-synthesis convergence) reframed the generation hierarchy as `ε_LX`-on-multiplicity acting through a diabatic freeze-in amplitude `exp(−S₀·C₂(p,q))` on the Casimir grading. This wave closes three questions in dependency order:

- **Item 9 (S100a-FREEZEIN-OVERCONSTRAINED)** — the keystone: fit only `{S₀, |w|}` to the three charged-lepton masses and `arg(w)` to ONE CKM datum (3 real inputs), then PREDICT the six quark mass ratios, the three CKM mixing angles, and J_CP with NO further freedom (~12 held-out predictions). The fit is PDG-self-contained; the Wave-2 `|w|` is a cross-check seed only. A clean FAIL closes the dynamical-freeze-in corridor — pre-registered as a valid informative boundary, not a deficiency.
- **Item 10 (S100a-ENVELOPE-OVERDETERMINE)** — derive the diagonal exponent TWICE: greybody filter at the SONIC (Mach-1) surface `κ_SONIC` vs Item-9's `S₀·C₂`. Coincidence = genuine independent confirmation that one operator wears two faces (production amplitude ↔ greybody filter).
- **Item 11 (S100a-S0-THRESHOLD-JOINT)** — is `S₀ = (ε_LX-split scale)/(horizon κ)` FIXED by the KK-threshold machinery (KK-THRESHOLD-64)? If yes, envelope magnitude AND slope close JOINTLY (the highest-leverage open question the panel flagged); if no, `S₀` stays an empirical anchor (the S99 W3-2 neutrino pattern).

**Carry-forward source**: lizzi V.3 / mack V.3 / phonon-first V.4 / quantum-foam V.3 / volovik V.4 (Item 9, convergence 5); lizzi V.4 / mack V.4 / phonon-first V.5 / quantum-foam V.4 / volovik V.5 (Item 10, convergence 5); phonon-first V.6 + QF V.4 (Item 11, convergence 2). Merged S99 IDs for Item 9: S99-CF-FREEZEIN-BLOCK-OVERDETERMINED / S100a-FREEZE-IN-PREDICT / S100a-FREEZEIN-PREDICT / S100a-FREEZEIN-MASS-MIXING.

## §W3-10. S100a-ENVELOPE-OVERDETERMINE

```yaml
# ---- Identity (6 fields) ----
gate_id: "S100a-ENVELOPE-OVERDETERMINE"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[SIGN]"
classification: "PHONONIC"
agent_type: "hawking-theorist"
hypothesis: >
  The diagonal freeze-in exponent is derivable TWO independent ways and they coincide:
  (route A) the greybody filter at the SONIC (Mach-1) surface, exponent 2*pi*omega/kappa_SONIC,
  and (route B) the transit freeze-in amplitude exponent S0*C2 from Item 9. PASS iff
  |2*pi*omega/kappa_SONIC - S0*C2| / (S0*C2) < 0.1 across the heavy sector pair — i.e. the same
  operator wears two faces (production amplitude AND greybody filter).

method:
  description: >
    (1) Compute the greybody exponent at the SONIC surface kappa_SONIC = 2*pi*T_acoustic
    = 28/125*pi (Sage-exact from canonical T_acoustic = 0.112 M_KK, S63), the v=c_BLV Mach-1
    crossing. EXCLUDE kappa_GH=1.365 (Gibbons-Hawking) and the a2/a4 thermodynamic surfaces;
    kappa_SONIC is FIBER-ACOUSTIC (functional-INDEPENDENT per lizzi pin — an a_n-gradient kappa
    would contaminate a regulator-invariant ratio).
    (2) Use ε_LX frequency offsets Delta_omega ~ 0.9 M_KK (one-fiber-gap) for the heavy pair.
    (3) Load S0 from Item 9 (s100a_freezein_overconstrained.npz). Compute S0*C2 for the heavy
    sectors C2 in {3, 6}.
    (4) Form the relative discrepancy per sector and gate.
    Greybody transmission cross-check: Gamma(omega)*exp(-2*pi*omega/kappa) is the analog-horizon
    transmission (S43/S95 greybody machinery); the EXPONENT is the over-determined quantity.
  producing_script: "computations/_shared/s100a_envelope_overdetermine.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "ratio"
  form: "|2*pi*omega/kappa_SONIC - S0*C2| / (S0*C2) <= 0.1  (per heavy sector; PASS = all heavy sectors satisfy)"

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "0.1"
  direction: "<="

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: >
    The 10% relative-discrepancy band is the pre-registered "same OOM, O(1) factor" closure
    tolerance (QF V.4 numeric band). kappa_SONIC = 28/125*pi is analytically exact;
    S0*C2 is Item-9 output. The boundary is a relative-error inequality with an
    analytically-fixed LHS denominator.

# (4) reachable_rationals
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false
  mesh_density: "continuous  # relative-discrepancy is a continuous quantity; kappa_SONIC is the exact rational 28/125*pi"

# (5) machinery_pin_map
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "2  # heavy sector pair: C2 in {3, 6} for (1,1)/(3,0)"
  L_max: "N/A — kappa_SONIC and S0 are scalar inputs; C2 is analytic; no D_K diagonalization"
  scan_range: "N/A — fixed two-sector evaluation, not a scan"
  step_size: "N/A"
  tolerance: "0.1  # the GATE relative-discrepancy band (pre-registered, QF V.4)"
  scheme: "FW"
  convention: "RATIO  # relative-discrepancy convention; kappa_SONIC is fiber-acoustic functional-INDEPENDENT"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "numpy.linalg  # scalar arithmetic; CPU trivial"
  # CONDITIONAL pins:
  regulator_pin: >
    N/A — kappa_SONIC is a FIBER-ACOUSTIC surface gravity (2*pi*T_acoustic), NOT an
    a_n-gradient surface. The lizzi pin EXCLUDES a_n-gradient kappa surfaces precisely
    because they are functional-dependent; the gate uses the regulator-invariant
    fiber-acoustic kappa only. No Seeley-DeWitt a_n is cited.
  publication_precision: "5  # kappa_SONIC published at 5 sig figs = 0.70372 (Sage-exact 28/125*pi)"
  # SOURCE-RECONCILED pin (Class-8.3 publication-precision; documented below):
  kappa_SONIC: >
    28/125*pi = 0.7037167544041137 M_KK (Sage-exact, derived from canonical T_acoustic=0.112).
    NOT the context-header literal 0.7048 (see Source-Reconciliation note in the Input-SHA Ledger).
  Delta_omega: "0.9  # (local) M_KK; ε_LX one-fiber-gap heavy-pair frequency offset (post shape-preserving-squaring halving)"

# (6) audit_discriminators
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "the diagonal exponent is the SAME via greybody-filter and via freeze-in amplitude".
    Step 1 — Definitions:
      kappa_SONIC = 2*pi*T_acoustic                 [T_acoustic = 0.112 M_KK, canonical S63]
      greybody exponent E_A(omega) = 2*pi*omega/kappa_SONIC   [analog-horizon transmission exponent]
      freeze-in exponent E_B = S0*C2                [Item 9 diabatic amplitude exp(-S0*C2)]

      => 4-dp round = 0.7037  (volovik's value; residual |exact-0.7037| = 2.289e-5, log10 = -4.640)
      => context-header 0.7048: |exact - 0.7048| = 1.083e-3 (log10 = -2.965) ~= 47x the rounding residual
      => 0.7048 is NOT 2*pi*0.112; it is transcription drift. CANONICAL pin = 28/125*pi.
    Step 4 — Direction read-off:
      PASS-direction: E_A(omega) and E_B = S0*C2 coincide within 10% for the heavy pair
      => |E_A - E_B|/E_B < 0.1. The closer the ratio to 1, the stronger the
      "one operator, two faces" identification on the production/filter axis.
```

### Source-Reconciliation note (Class-8.3 publication-precision + Class-(f) PIN-PLACEHOLDER) — κ_SONIC

The context-header for Item 10 quotes `κ_SONIC = 0.7048 M_KK` (= "2π·0.112") AND flags a 4th-digit discrepancy to reconcile AT PLAN TIME via the canonical. **Reconciliation (Sage QQ, this plan-freeze)**:

```
T_acoustic = 0.112 M_KK  (canonical, S63; get_constant("T_acoustic") = 0.112)
2π·0.112 = 28/125·π = 0.7037167544041137   (Sage-exact)
  rounded 4 dp = 0.7037   (volovik's synthesis value)
  |0.7037167544 − 0.7037| = 2.289e-5   (log10 = −4.640)   ← correct 4-dp rounding
  |0.7037167544 − 0.7048| = 1.083e-3   (log10 = −2.965)   ← ~47× the rounding residual
```

**Verdict**: the canonical-derived value is `28/125·π = 0.70371675…`; volovik's `0.7037` is its correct 4-dp rounding (residual 2.3e-5); the context-header's `0.7048` is **transcription drift** (residual 1.08e-3, ~47× larger — it is NOT `2π·0.112`). Both W3-10 and W3-11 `machinery_pin_map` carry the **Sage-exact rational `28/125·π`** as the κ_SONIC pin, published at 5 sig figs (`0.70372`), per the Class-8.3 publication-precision discipline (`.claude/rules/epistemic-discipline.md §"Publication-Precision Pre-Registration"`) and the substrate-first sourcing axis (`.claude/rules/substrate-first-canonical-sourcing.md §(v)` Class-(f) — placeholder/drifted literal superseded by the substrate canonical). Using `0.7048` would bias the greybody exponent low by 0.154% — inside the 10% gate band, but a publication-precision defect that propagates downstream.
